clinician.final_diagnosis: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (diagnosed via biopsy of the renal mass)
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 77-year-old male presented with severe back pain following a mechanical fall, with physical examination demonstrating midthoracic point tenderness. Initial CT thoracolumbar spine performed on admission revealed acute fractures through the T7 vertebral body and left pedicle with associated T6-T7 disk space widening, and incidentally identified an exophytic renal mass. Subsequent dedicated CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast renal mass protocol characterized this as a 3.8 cm right mid pole renal mass with internal septations and a 0.8 cm solid nodular component, classified as Bosniak type III. The clinical trajectory involved workup of this incidentally discovered renal mass, which was subsequently biopsied per the known diagnosis.
